profile.headline: AI Transformation & Strategy | SWE @ Salesforce | MBA Candidate @ USC Marshall
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with experience at IBM and Salesforce, where I’ve been recognized with the Rising Star Award and the Inclusive Product Award for building solutions that balance innovation with equity. Currently an MBA candidate at USC Marshall, I bridge deep technical expertise with business strategy to create technology that scales responsibly. Passionate about inclusive design, AI ethics, and solving real problems. 

Currently focused on expanding my impact at the intersection of AI, product strategy, and responsible innovation, building scalable systems while shaping how technology is designed, governed, and delivered. Interested in technical leadership, product ownership, and cross-functional roles that influence both roadmap and outcomes.
